Click here to learn more.

Our goal is to make quality dental care affordable. Gentle Dental welcomes most dental insurance plans. Our special offers and extended payment options make dental care affordable for most budgets. We also accept Care Credit and Essential Dental discount dental plan. During your visit, our trained staff can assist you in meeting your financial obligations.
We are in-network providers with most major dental insurance companies. Call us to confirm coverage.
Credit card and personal checks accepted.

Care Credit is a third-party healthcare credit card that helps finance healthcare related costs. Care Credit extends special financing options that you can’t get when using your Visa or MasterCard. Whether you use your healthcare credit card to cover your deductible, or to pay for treatments and procedures not covered by insurance, CareCredit helps make them possible today.

Gentle Dental accepts Essential Dental Plan which allows members to receive the dental care they need at the savings they can afford. Get instant access to significant savings on all dental services plus free exams and x-rays. Choose individual, two-individual, or family coverage and enjoy peace of mind knowing you can maintain your oral health. The Essential Dental Plan is not insurance.

Gentle Dental partners with Sunbit to pay for treatment over time. Sunbit allows patients to split their treatment cost into monthly payments for up to 72 months. Over 85% of patients who apply are approved.

Yes, we do! We are always accepting new patients. Our $79 New Patient Offer is a great introduction to our practice. It includes It includes an exam, x-rays, cleaning, and treatment plan. Schedule an appointment today.
Yes! Gentle Dental Brighton is open on Saturdays and is also open in the evenings. Call today to request an appointment.
Yes, we do. Our dentists and dental hygienists have the training and expertise to meet the unique dental needs of your infants, children, adolescents, and persons with special health care needs.
We provide extensive care and serve patients in Brighton, Chestnut Hill, Oak Square, and Allston and anyone from beyond these areas who seeks Gentle Dental care.

Gentle Dental Brighton is a friendly dentist office in Brighton that provides comprehensive dental care to its patients. Your search for an affordable dentist office near home ends here. At Gentle Dental, patients receive award-winning dental care from the best dentists in the neighborhood. With the latest in dental technology including digital low radiation x-rays, 3D scanning and intraoral cameras, Gentle Dental Brighton is the best dentist in Brighton. Come visit our dentist office in Brighton today!

Gentle Dental Brighton sees emergency dental cases the same day as it can be acutely painful and discomforting for the patient. Gentle Dental Brighton provides emergency dental services and tends to dental emergencies such as chipped, cracked or missing teeth, tooth or Gum Abscess, toothache, mouth pain, bitten/cut tongue or cheek, broken braces wires or brackets, jaw pain and other such dental emergencies cases. Gentle Dental Brighton provides emergency care that can help alleviate your pain and discomfort and help prevent permanent damage or bone loss. Just call to schedule a dental emergency appointment today.
Call our office for a same-day appointment at (617) 562-1100
Yes, Gentle Dental Brighton does accept Essential Dental Plan and Care Credit.
Yes, we offer Invisalign treatment at Gentle Dental Brighton.
Gentle Dental Brighton accepts most dental insurance plans but does not currently accept Medicare.
Gentle Dental Brighton is a multi-specialty dental practice seeing patients for all phases of dental care from children to adults, general dentistry to specialty care.
Yes, Gentle Dental Brighton offers dental services for kids.
